title_en: Capcom Sets Monster Hunter Wilds Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date for December 2026
summary_en: Capcom has announced a Monster Hunter Wilds Nintendo Switch 2 release date of December 4, 2026.
body_en:
Capcom has announced a Monster Hunter Wilds Nintendo Switch 2 release date of December 4, 2026.
The latest entry in the publisher’s monster-hunting series kicked off today’s September 2026 Nintendo Direct. Additional details about the release include confirmation that the Switch 2 version of Monster Hunter Wilds will come with local play and all previous title updates.
In case you forgot, this is Nintendo’s second Direct of the week. For everything announced during yesterday’s Zelda Direct, click here . For everything announced during today’s Direct, click here .
